surface: WooPayments' onboarding (Activate payments: business location, legal entity and its structure, goods or services)

source.held_as: the option wcpay_onboarding_fields_data in options.tsv (PHP-serialized), which WooPayments fills from its server

shape: {data: {business_types: [{key, name, types: [{key, name, structures: [{key, name}]}]}], mccs_display_tree: [{id, type, title, items: [...]}], industry_to_mcc: {industry: mcc id}, __locale}, fetched, errored, consecutive_errors}
items: items.jsonl: one line per country of business_types, per group of mccs_display_tree, and the industry_to_mcc map, as WooPayments states them
